thread:
srini: Heads up — after the firewall cutover in usw3 this morning we're seeing GPU nodes fail nodejoin because the audit-shipper can't reach the SIEM endpoint. onboarding errors look like `keystore: timeout while fetching grant` and `audit-shipper: 503`. anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
ops-bot: [ALERT] audit-shipper.usw3 failed 12/15 attempts to deliver to siem.prod.internal — rate=12m, last=1748009902
deploy-bot: terraform apply finished: `module/network.firewall_rule.audit_ingest` updated by @infra-ops at 1748009850
maya: I think the new egress default-deny rule blocked the NAT path used by the SIEM ingesters. SIEM lives in a peered account, not public. Short-term we can open egress to the SIEM aggregator CIDR, but that's not ideal for long-term. :grimacing:
jamie: Confirming logs — flowlogs show `REJECT` to 10.180.22.0/24 from keystore-proxy pods. Suggest temporary allowlist for `siem-agg-10.180.22.0/24` + a canary.
luis: downside: opening that CIDR will let audit traffic bypass our proxy for a bit. We'll lose enriched logs for the window. Also NAT egress costs spike if we route via NAT instead of privatelink.
srini: Options: 1) Revert firewall rule (fast but risky), 2) allowlist siem CIDR (fast, minimal RCAs), 3) deploy a short-lived proxy in same VPC that forwards to SIEM over existing peering. Which do we want?
maya: 3 seems safest (no rule rollback). I can spin a small L7 proxy (nginx) with TLS mTLS to SIEM, put it in a restricted subnet, and update audit-shipper to point to it. Up in ~15m.
jamie: If we go with proxy, add a fail-open to audit-shipper so nodejoin doesn't block on audit post. We don't want GPU nodes stuck because audit ingest timed out. Add `AUDIT_POST_TIMEOUT=2s` env override for nodejoin.
luis: Also: KMS grant TTLs — some of the keystore errors are from grants expiring while the proxy handshake retries. We should increase grant TTL to 10m while we patch. I can open a grant patch now.
srini: Good call. Also need a mitigation for cost: if proxy forces audit traffic via NAT, we risk NAT bytes. Suggest we enable sampling on audit-shipper for the emergency window (sample_rate=0.1) to limit bytes.
maya: Work plan: 1) luis bumps KMS grant TTL (assigned luis) 2) jamie sets AUDIT_POST_TIMEOUT and sampling env for shipper (assigned jamie) 3) maya deploys proxy in restricted subnet and updates shipper host (assigned maya) 4) ops-bot will monitor canary and flowlogs for 1h, revert if errors.
ops-bot: acknowledged. will post canary metrics to #monitoring every 5m.
deploy-bot: quick note — the change that caused this was `network:default-deny-egress` PR #3892. tagging @infra-ops for postmortem.
srini: If proxy plan can't be done within 30m, revert rule as emergency and we'll do a scoped replacement later. Cost tradeoff OK.
jamie: I'll patch the shipper env and push a canary now. command: ```kubectl set env deploy/audit-shipper AUDIT_POST_TIMEOUT=2s AUDIT_SAMPLE_RATE=0.1 -n infra````
luis: KMS command I'm running: ```aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/keystore --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-node --operations Encrypt Decrypt --retire-on-day 1``` (will adjust TTL via grant expiry param)
maya: proxy up at 1748011200 in restricted subnet `subnet-priv-heat`. updated audit-shipper config to `https://audit-proxy.usw3.internal:8443` and restarted pods.
ops-bot: canary: success=18 fail=1 latency_p50=120ms latency_p95=420ms — continuing to monitor
srini: Nice. Keep an eye on KMS errors; if we still see `keystore: grant denied` we may need to broaden IAM condition for the warm pool role.
jamie: Can we also add a short-term per-account allowlist to avoid hitting NAT? I'll open a small fw rule to permit `siem-agg` from the shipper subnet only, expires in 2h.
luis: Done: added `fw-rule-allow-siem-2h` at 1748012100 — limited to shipper subnet and audited.
srini: OK closing plan: proxy + KMS TTL bump + sampling + targeted allowlist. Postmortem later to decide whether default-deny policy needs exception lists for cross-account peering endpoints. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: [INFO] thread closed for 1748009999 after canary stable for 30m
